scope: Bounded pure-Gleam repair of an independently observed numeric overflow in accepted RAG cache semantic input. Scale-normalize norm and cosine intermediates while retaining the established 1.0e100 accepted embedding boundary. This excludes retrieval, inference, persistence, network, deployment, task completion, and admission.

fmea_modes.cause: Newton iteration begins at sum-of-squares/2 and the resulting norm product overflows for accepted vectors.
fmea_modes.controls: Normalize by each vector's maximum magnitude before norm and cosine products, constraining intermediate magnitudes by vector length.
